+    def decode(self, ids):
+        # given ids (list of integers), return Python string
+        vocab = self.vocab
+        if len(vocab) and max(vocab) == len(vocab) - 1:
+            vocab_list = [vocab[i] for i in range(len(vocab))]
+            part_bytes = []
+            append = part_bytes.append
+            for idx in ids:
+                if idx >= 0:
+                    try:
+                        append(vocab_list[idx])
+                        continue
+                    except IndexError:
+                        pass
+                raise KeyError(idx)
+            text_bytes = b"".join(part_bytes)
+        else:
+            text_bytes = b"".join([vocab[idx] for idx in ids])
+        text = text_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        return text
+

actions.reason: Use a dense vocabulary list fast path in BasicTokenizer.decode when the vocabulary ids are contiguous and the input ids are a list or tuple. This avoids per-token dictionary lookup on the common decode path while falling back to the dictionary path for negative, out-of-range, or non-index ids.
